title: pkcs1_v15_unpad_decrypt is not constant-time
description: The loop in pkcs1_v15_unpad_decrypt (wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c) exits early when it finds the 0x00 separator byte. Execution time varies with plaintext length. Relevant question: does this constitute an exploitable Bleichenbacher-style padding oracle when (a) the RSA operation itself is server-side and (b) the timing of the client-side unpadding is not exposed over a network boundary? Standard guidance says constant-time unpadding always, but the practical attack surface here is different from a TLS server. Research needed: characterize actual attacker model for a PKCS#11 library used in embedded/secure systems.
